event: Determine the relative direction of a creak and thud sound from a virtual robot's perspective.

sounding_object.description: A large, light gray fabric L-shaped sectional sofa. It has several throw pillows, including yellow and patterned ones. The sound (creak and thud) originates from the main seating section when a person sits down on it.

reference_object.object_name: Light-gray armchair closer to the wall painting
reference_object.description: A light-gray upholstered armchair with a blue rectangular throw pillow. It is one of two similar armchairs and is positioned closer to a wall adorned with a colorful, circular mosaic-style painting, near a large arched window and the front entrance area of the house.

facing_object.description: A set of two circular nested coffee tables. The larger table has a light-colored top (possibly stone or light wood) and the smaller, lower table also has a light top. Both have dark metal frames. Various items like snacks (a bag of pistachios, a bag of pretzels), remotes, and a small bowl are on them, placed in the center of the living room area.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the light-gray armchair closer to the wall painting and facing a set of nested coffee tables, when the creak and thud sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
